svg.title: Identity token ≠ access token ≠ agent identity
svg.desc: Use the credential intended for the receiver. A JWT encoding alone tells you none of its permissions. IAP egress policy and IAP enabled directly on Cloud Run are distinct configurations.

g.text: Identity token ≠ access token ≠ agent identity
Use the credential intended for the receiver. A JWT encoding alone tells you none of its permissions.
Receiver: MCP application. Audience: patient-records-mcp. Header: X-Clinician-Token.
Receiver: Google APIs (Model Armor, Vertex AI, Registry, Telemetry); plain OAuth token across gateway TLS.
The agent's own Google ID token for a private backend
Receiver: Cloud Run ingress (run.invoker on the agent principal). Audience: service URL. No rows.
SPIFFE principal and platform workload credentials
Receiver: gateway/IAP policy, and Cloud Run IAM as the invoker. Never the clinician token.
A downstream assertion header is not a caller credential
Do not substitute X-Goog-Iap-Jwt-Assertion for verified identity or gateway evidence.
IAP egress policy and IAP enabled directly on Cloud Run are distinct configurations.
